This distinguishes every item from every other item, so the code-to-item-number tie is VERIFIED; the number-to-wording tie is Table 5's explicit numbering in the same paper. NOT established: that Table 5's Portuguese reprint matches the Carvalho et al. 2013 form word for word (not retrieved), and the direction of the underlying Likert (anchors not recovered; option_text blank).
